summary.headline: Mercury, Moon, and Luminary Fortitude
summary.text: Chapters XVII–XVIII discuss the swift-changing effects of Mercury and the Moon, planetary combustion under the Sun, significators of the year and king, and the fortitude of the luminaries through aspects from houses, exaltation, triplicity, terms, and places of strength.
